name: AccessibleWebBot
description: The crawler Accessible Web runs for its RAMP accessibility-monitoring product. It reads customers' sitemaps to find newly added pages and fetches the individual pages RAMP users ask to have scanned for accessibility problems, in both a plain and a headless-browser profile. The operator documents both user agents and a reverse-DNS method for confirming that a request really came from it, and explains how to allow the bot past robots.txt rules meant for search engines.
